Article Title: 'I apologise on his behalf': Tamil Nadu CM Vijay after minister's Karunanidhi reference
Article Text:
Vijay apologises on minister's behalf for his Karunanidhi reference

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Tamil Nadu chief minister C Vijay Joseph apologised in the assembly on Monday after a minister referred to former CM and DMK patriarch late M Karunanidhi by name without using the customary respectful honorific.State forest minister R V Ranjith Kumar’s reference to the late DMK leader as “Karunanidhi”, without the traditional “Kalaignar” (scholar), triggered protests from opposition DMK members.Vijay intervened to defuse the tension, admitting that the reference was inappropriate and apologising on the minister’s behalf.“I apologise on his behalf,” Vijay said.The row erupted during a debate on demands for grants for the health and revenue departments. Ranjith Kumar was criticising alleged cash-for-votes practices and referred to the controversial “Thirumangalam formula”.He claimed that up to Rs 1,500 per vote had been distributed in his Kancheepuram constituency during previous elections. He contrasted this with the current government, saying it came to power without distributing money for votes.While referring to past election tactics, Ranjith Kumar mentioned Karunanidhi without the customary “Kalaignar” or “former chief minister” prefix. DMK members, led by former minister K K S S R Ramachandran, immediately protested, citing the assembly’s long-standing convention of using respectful titles for revered leaders.Vijay then halted the forest minister’s speech and intervened to prevent the protest from escalating, acknowledging that referring to the late leader without the customary honorific was inappropriate.
Article Summary: State forest minister R V Ranjith Kumar’s reference to the late DMK leader as “Karunanidhi’, without the traditional “Kalaignar’ (scholar) triggered protests from opposition DMK members. Chief minister C Vijay Joseph intervened to defuse the tension.

Article Title: AAP leader Satyendar Jain arrested in Delhi Jal Board corruption case
Article Text:
AAP leader Satyendar Jain arrested.

Kejriwal, Sisodia attack BJP

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader Satyendar Jain was arrested in connection with alleged corruption in the Delhi Jal Board, an official told news agency ANI.The Delhi government's Anti-Corruption Branch (ABC) has arrested six people in connection with the case.Those arrested include former Delhi minister Satyendar Kumar Jain, former Delhi Jal Board CEO Udit Prakash Rai, former contractual consultant Ankit Srivastava, and three private persons, Nagendra Yadav, Raja Kumar Kurra and Pankaj Verma.The arrests were made in connection with an FIR registered by the Anti-Corruption Branch on May 11, 2024, under provisions of the Prevention of Corruption Act and the Indian Penal Code.The case includes charges under provisions relating to bribery, criminal breach of trust, cheating and criminal conspiracy.The case was registered on the complaint of Directorate of Vigilance, GNCTD regarding large-scale irregularities, manipulation of tender conditions and criminal conspiracy in the tendering process relating to augmentation/upgradation of Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs) of the Delhi Jal Board (DJB).AAP chief and former Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal attacked the BJP over Jain's arrest, saying his party colleague was arrested on the "BJP's behest".Calling the case 'fake,' Kejriwal said: “The BJP’s cup of sins is now full. No matter how much authoritarianism they resort to, the end of the Modi government is now certain. The entire Aam Aadmi Party and the people of the country stand firmly with Satyendar Jain."Ex-Delhi deputy CM Manish Sisodia linked Satyendar Jain's arrest to the Punjab polls, saying BJP was back with its election-time tactics.""Just ahead of the Punjab elections, Satyendar Jain, who is the party’s co-incharge for Punjab, has been arrested. He was earlier kept in jail for two and a half years in a false case, and now there is yet another false case. From the Gen Z protests to allegations of donation irregularities over the Ram Temple and the E20 issue, the BJP is facing questions on several fronts and has once again resorted to its old electoral tactic of using the ED, ACB and CBI,” Sisodia wrote on X
Article Summary: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader Satyendar Jain was arrested in connection with alleged corruption in the Delhi Jal Board. The Delhi government's Anti- Corruption Branch (ABC) has arrested six people. The case includes charges under provisions relating to bribery, criminal breach of trust, cheating and criminal conspiracy.

Article Title: ‘Don’t lie to children’: Rahul slams Rijiju over his 'no one harmed' during CJP stir remark
Article Text:
Rahul said he had personally met some of the injured protesters and alleged that videos of the police action had been widely circulated.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Tuesday hit out at parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju after he defended the handling of recent student protests by Delhi police . Rijiju had praised the Delhi Police for managing large student demonstrations without any deaths or serious injuries.“Not a single person was harmed; not a single person suffered a broken bone. Not even one protester is in the hospital with a serious injury. Consider the scale of this movement: thousands turned up, and so many criminals infiltrated under the guise of students,” Rijiju said.Responding on X, Rahul accused the government of ignoring injuries suffered during the protests and questioned Rijiju's call to praise the police.“Ministers of the Modi government are saying that “the Delhi Police should be praised.” Half a kilometer from Parliament, pellet guns were fired at peaceful students, lathis studded with nails were used, one child's eye was lost, one girl's ear was severed. Should we praise this brutality?” the leader of opposition in Lok Sabha wrote.Rahul said he had personally met some of the injured protesters and alleged that videos of the police action had been widely circulated.“The fundamental mantra of this government is untruth and violence. First, beat the children with lathis, then claim that nothing happened at all,” he said.He also criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah over their response to the protests.“Throughout the entire session, the “missing” Amit Shah kept running from the opposition. And the Prime Minister has not apologized to the students to this day,” Rahul wrote.Rijiju, meanwhile, said the government remained committed to protecting students' interests and promised strict action against those responsible for examination leaks.He also claimed that political groups, including the Aam Aadmi Party, Bhim Army and Samajwadi Party, had joined the demonstrations and incited violence.“Furthermore, more than half the people, whether from the Aam Aadmi Party, the dafli-playing agitators, the Bhim Army, or the Samajwadi Party, came and incited others to violence; yet, not a single casualty occurred,” he said.“We respect the students' sentiments. The Prime Minister introduced such a good law and took step after step, promising to work for their future,” he said.
Article Summary: Kiren Rijiju had praised the Delhi Police for managing large student demonstrations without any deaths or serious injuries. Rahul accused the government of ignoring injuries suffered during the protests. He also criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah over their response.

Article Title: 'Dignity of CM blown away': DMK takes dig at Vijay over Trisha's front-row seat at I-Day event
Article Text:
DMK mouthpiece attacks Vijay

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam ( DMK ) has launched a sharp attack on Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay over actor Trisha Krishnan 's presence at the state's Independence Day celebrations, questioning her front-row seat and the exchange of salutes between the two during the official ceremony at Fort St George.The attack came through the DMK mouthpiece Murasoli, whose editorial took aim at Vijay under the headline, “fear that came to CM in three months.”Vijay had hoisted the national flag at the Independence Day celebrations in Chennai on August 15, with actor Trisha seated in the front row alongside his parents.The strongly-worded editorial began with a pointed remark: "CM Vijay's pride was blown away when he hoisted the flag on Independence Day."Though the editorial did not name Trisha, its reference to the actress was clear. Taking a veiled swipe at the chief minister, Murasoli wrote, "The scene of the actress sitting in the front row and the two of them saluting each other could not be tolerated by those who voted for him. The person who tries to justify it by making it a matter of honour is the chief minister of Tamil Nadu today."The editorial sharpened its attack further, saying, "In just three months, he has become fearful about his influence and position."The broadside against TVK chief Vijay comes weeks after DMK leader Udhayanidhi Stalin was taken for police questioning over remarks made during a protest.Udhayanidhi later clarified that his comments were not directed at the actor.On the same day, the Madras high court granted him bail.
Article Summary: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam ( DMK ) has launched a sharp attack on Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay over actor Trisha Krishnan's presence at the state's Independence Day celebrations. The attack came through the DMK mouthpiece Murasoli, whose editorial took aim at Vijay.

NEW DELHI: The BJP on Tuesday appointed state in-charges for poll-bound Uttar Pradesh and Punjab, which will vote early next year.In Uttar Pradesh, where the saffron party will seek a third consecutive term, BJP national president Nitin Nabin appointed national general secretary and Rajya Sabha MP Vinod Tawde as the state in-charge, with national secretary Jagdish Ishwarbhai Patel serving as his co-incharge.In Punjab, where the ruling AAP and the opposition Congress are the main contenders, BJP national general secretary and Rajya Sabha member Satish Poonia has been appointed the sole in-charge.The appointments came a day after the BJP unveiled a new team of national office-bearers to assist party president Nitin Nabin. Article Title: 'Ready to show degree but ask pawpaw too': CJP chief Dipke amid row over Boston education
Article Text:
CJP chief Abhijeet Dipke offers to show his Boston University degree amid questions over his educational credentials.

NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) chief Abhijeet Dipke has offered to show his degree from Boston University amid questions over his educational background, while challenging Prime Minister Narendra Modi to do the same.Addressing the controversy in a social media post, Dipke said he was willing to provide documents to establish that he had attended the US university.“Hello everyone, I’ve been noticing for the last few days that people have been calling me a fraud and saying I never went to Boston University. I am ready to show my degree. But will your Pawpaw show his degree?” he said.“I am ready to show my degree but what about pawpaw? I am ready. I have all the documents,” he added.A community note attached to his post, however, said records relating to PM Modi's educational qualifications had already been made public.“Narendra Modi’s Bachelor’s and Master’s degree records have been publicly available for a considerable period of time,” the note said, while linking to a 2016 BJP post that showcased Modi's BA and MA degree records.In a separate post, Dipke drew a comparison between Boston University and Delhi University , asking why the latter had not highlighted PM Modi's association with the institution.“Boston University published an article about me for being their alumnus. Why doesn’t DU proudly celebrate Modi as their alumnus? He is, after all, the Prime Minister of India. Shouldn’t they be flexing about it instead of trying to hide his degree?” he said.This post also attracted a community note, which stated that Delhi University had published a list of Union cabinet ministers who were its alumni and that PM Modi was included in the list.Dipke has earlier said that he received a scholarship from Boston University and financed the remaining expenses through an education loan, which he is still repaying.The 30-year-old holds a Master of Science degree in Public Relations from Boston University. He returned to India in June and led the Cockroach Janta Party's agitation over the alleged NEET-UG 2026 paper leak, with the protests eventually leading to the resignation of then education minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
Article Summary: CJP chief Abhijeet Dipke offers to show his Boston University degree amid questions over his educational credentials. He challenges Prime Minister Narendra Modi to do the same. A community note attached to his post, however, said records relating to PM Modi's educational qualifications had already been made public.

Article Title: Vande Mataram row: Congress hits out at Shah for demanding apology
Article Text: NEW DELHi: Attacking home minister Amit Shah for demanding an apology over the Vande Mataram row, Congress claimed the minister had insulted Bhimrao Ambedkar's memory in Rajya Sabha and that he owes allegiance to an organisation that did not unfurl the tricolour at its headquarters till 2002 - in what were allusions to Shah's controversial comments in the Upper house in Dec 2024 and to the RSS.AICC spokesperson Jairam Ramesh alleged, "A man who insulted Ambedkar on the floor of the Rajya Sabha on December 17, 2024. A man who belongs to an ideology that did not see it fit to unfurl the tiranga at its headquarters till January 2002. A man who orchestrated the Delhi Police's brutalities on peacefully protesting youth. Such a man is now demanding an apology from the Congress to divert attention away from the real issues of the day and away from colossal failures of his and his Sahib's. " TNN
Article Summary: Home minister Amit Shah has demanded an apology over the Vande Mataram row. Congress claimed the minister had insulted Bhimrao Ambedkar's memory in Rajya Sabha and that he owes allegiance to an organisation that did not unfurl the tricolour at its headquarters till 2002.

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday asked the Allahabad high court not to proceed with a case against Lok Sabha leader of opposition and former Congress president Rahul Gandhi involving allegations of disproportionate assets.The top court also directed the CBI and Enforcement Directorate (ED) not to submit any probe report to any authority, including the Allahabad high court, in connection with the alleged assets case arising from an investigation ordered by the HC.During the hearing, the CBI said that if the complainant’s allegations were found to be true, the matter would amount to a “gross disproportionate assets case”.The apex court also asked the Allahabad HC to defer its August 20 hearing in the matter until the Supreme Court hears the case next.

Article Title: Rahul Gandhi defamation case: Savarkar’s grandson admits Nathuram, Gopal Godse were active RSS members
Article Text:
Pune:





In a significant development in the defamation case involving Congress leader Rahul Gandhi , filed by Savarkar’s grandson Satyaki Savarkar, the complainant on Monday admitted that Nathuram Godse and his brother Gopal Godse were “active members” of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).The admission came during further cross-examination of Satyaki Savarkar by Gandhi’s counsel Milind D Pawar, appearing for Rahul Gandhi, before judicial magistrate first class (JMFC) Amol Shriram Shinde. The deposition records Satyaki as stating: “It is true to say that, my grandfathers Gopal Godse and Nathuram Godse were active members of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh.”The cross-examination also brought out the family links between the Savarkars and Godses. Satyaki said Gopal Godse was his maternal grandfather and Sindhu Godse his maternal grandmother, while his mother was Himani Savarkar. He also confirmed that Gopal and Nathuram Godse were real brothers and described Nathuram as his grand-uncle. He further agreed that the Savarkar and Godse families were related. The witness also admitted that his mother and Gopal Godse worked for the Hindu Mahasabha until their deaths.The cross-examination also dealt with the 1948 assassination of Mahatma Gandhi. Satyaki agreed that Gandhi was assassinated at Birla House in Delhi on Jan 30, 1948, and that Gopal Godse and Vinayak Damodar Savarkar were accused in the case.The defence also questioned Satyaki about an alleged interview given by Gopal Godse to a monthly magazine on Jan 28, 1994. Satyaki said he did not know about the interview. He similarly said he did not know whether Nathuram Godse had worked as an “intellectual executive” in 1944.The complainant’s lawyer, Sangram Kolhatkar, objected to some of the questions concerning the RSS and Digambar Badge, arguing that they were not related to the case. The court recorded that the objections would be decided at the time of the final decision.The cross-examination remained incomplete and was deferred to Sept 1.
Article Summary: Nathuram Godse and his brother Gopal Godse were ‘active members’ of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh. The admission came during further cross-examination of Satyaki Savarkar.

Article Title: Sanitation worker’s murder: AAP alleges cops kidnapped MLA; police deny charge
Article Text:
New Delhi:





Police Tuesday claimed to have detained AAP’s Kondli MLA Kuldeep Kumar for allegedly creating a ruckus and attempting to disrupt law and order in east Delhi’s Kalyanpuri over the murder of an on-duty sanitation worker Sunday.However, AAP alleged that cops in plain clothes “kidnapped” Kumar from his residence at 4am and took him to an undisclosed location because he was demanding Rs 1 crore compensation and a govt job for the kin of the deceased. The party also alleged that police broke CCTV cameras at the MLA’s home and took away the DVR.In the afternoon, party chief Arvind Kejriwal took to X to question PM Modi over Kumar’s whereabouts. “Where is our MLA? Your police is not telling us anything. If they can pick up an MLA from his home without any information or reason, where can the common man in this country go for help?” he posted.Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh claimed that even the police commissioner and DCP did not know where the MLA was kept throughout the day. Kumar wasn’t allowed to take his phone with him after he was picked up, AAP workers alleged.Kumar’s family filed a habeas corpus petition before Delhi High Court . During the hearing before a bench of Justices Navin Chawla and Ravinder Dudeja, senior advocate Shadan Farasat questioned the manner in which Kumar was detained, adding, “He was picked up at 4am, and couldn’t be contacted throughout the day”.Denying the charge that the MLA was abducted, police informed the court that Kumar was taken into preventive detention before being released. HC then disposed of the plea.Later, a senior police officer said that Kumar was detained at 5.15am under Section 65 of Delhi Police Act and released at 3.28 pm.“The MLA was allegedly instigating the family of Anil Kumar, the deceased, asking them to place his body on the road and not cremate him,” another officer said, adding that police also received information about a possible plan to block National Highway-24 over the issue.Multiple AAP functionaries like Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh and former CM Atishi tore into police over the MLA’s detention.However, Delhi BJP media head Praveen Shankar Kapoor accused AAP functionaries and the MLA of “politicising” the death and attempting to link a murder committed due to personal reasons with Delhi govt and Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD).“The private company, which had appointed the worker, offered appropriate compensation to his family Sunday itself. However, in order to further his political interests, the MLA allegedly pressured the family for two days and even prevented the post-mortem of the body from being conducted. Through his statements, the MLA also attempted to disturb the law-and-order situation, compelling police to take him for questioning,” said Kapoor, demanding that Kumar should apologise not only to the people of Delhi but also to the family of the deceased.Mayor Pravesh Wahi said, “We have directed the contracted company to give the family Rs 10 lakh as compensation. Also, a job for one of the family members on compassionate ground is being asked for,” he said.The MLA and local AAP workers, agitating against the murder, allegedly refused to allow Anil Kumar’s body to be taken out from the mortuary of Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital until their demands were met. Heavy police and paramilitary deployment was made at the hospital and Khichripur Bus Stand on NH-24 as sanitation workers and auto-tipper drivers gathered to demand justice.Police said a suspect has been arrested and that the killing appeared to be a case of mistaken identity.
Article Summary: Police claim to have detained AAP’s Kondli MLA Kuldeep Kumar for allegedly creating a ruckus over the murder of an on-duty sanitation worker Sunday. However, AAP alleged that cops in plain clothes “kidnapped’ Kumar from his residence at 4am and took him to an undisclosed location. Kumar's family filed a habeas corpus petition before Delhi High Court.

Article Title: OBC activist booked by Jalna police over remarks on Maratha women, expresses regret later
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





OBC activist Navnath Waghmare was booked by the Jalna police on Monday for allegedly making objectionable remarks about women from the Maratha community during an interview aired on a YouTube channel.The case was registered at the Kadim Jalna police station following a complaint by Suvarna Wagh, a resident of Old Jalna. Members of the Maratha community also gathered outside the police station, raised slogans against Waghmare and demanded action.Deputy superintendent of police Anant Kulkarni said the FIR was registered under BNS sections 79, 196(1), 353(2) and 352 for allegedly insulting the modesty of women and promoting enmity between communities.According to the complaint, Waghmare made the comments while referring to BJP politician Chandrashekhar Bawankule’s remarks about his family. The complainant alleged that the remarks insulted Maratha women, hurt community sentiments and were intended to create tension between Marathas and OBCs.Following the backlash, Waghmare expressed regret over his comments. “I have never made such statements earlier.The remarks came while responding to criticism by Manoj Jarange against Chandrashekhar Bawankule. I appeal to women across the state to understand my position and forgive me,” he said.However, Waghmare also questioned when Jarange would apologise for his alleged remarks against NCP politician Chhagan Bhujbal, the Munde siblings, and the chief minister and deputy chief ministers.Jarange hit back, saying he never comments on women while speaking on community issues. “You have crossed all limits by speaking about Maratha women,” Jarange said, warning that those making such remarks would not be spared.Police said further investigation is underway.
Article Summary: Navnath Waghmare was booked by the Jalna police on Monday for allegedly making objectionable remarks about women from the Maratha community. The case was registered following a complaint by Suvarna Wagh, a resident of Old Jalna. The complainant alleged that the remarks insulted Maratha women, hurt community sentiments and were intended to create tension.

Article Title: Will request Sharad Pawar to enlighten Rahul Gandhi on benefits of ethanol policy to farmers: Mushrif
Article Text:
Hasan Mushrif

Kolhapur

:

Praises roads in Gujarat





NCP leader and state minister Hasan Mushrif on Monday said he would request NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar to help educate leader of opposition and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi on the benefits of the ethanol blending policy for farmers.Mushrif was responding to questions about the Centre facing criticism from the opposition over ethanol blending in petrol. Recently, Gandhi released a video hinting that he would take up the ethanol issue.“Ethanol policy has benefited the sugar cane farmers. Mills are able to pay fair and remunerative prices (FRP) to farmers through revenue generated from ethanol sales. In Brazil, 100% blending is practiced. While there are complaints about mileage, these can be addressed,” Mushrif said.“Pawar had recently asked me to visit the farmers to see the technical experiments conducted to increase productivity. When I meet him, I will request him to enlighten Gandhi on how much the ethanol policy has benefited the farmers. I don’t understand what he hopes to achieve by causing losses to the farmers,” he added.The minister also said that Gandhi should stop calling PM Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah disrespectfully as both are much elder to him in age and the positions they hold.Talking about the road conditions in Nandurbar, district guardian minister Mushrif said, “I visit Nandurbar once or twice in a month. From Surat by road it takes three hours to reach Nandurbar. Of this two hour road is in Gujarat and the last one hour in Maharashtra. The roads in Gujarat are very good, but that one hour road in Nandurbar is in worst condition.”He added, “Therefore, I said I feel ashamed by the conditions of the roads in Nandurbar. Govts come and go, but everyone should think of using some sort of technology that stops roads from deteriorating during rainfall.”
Article Summary: Mushrif was responding to questions about the Centre facing criticism from the opposition over ethanol blending in petrol. Gandhi released a video hinting that he would take up the ethanol issue. Mushrif also said that Gandhi should stop calling PM Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah disrespectfully.

Article Title: Ambernath BJP-MNS clash: Case registered against 2 BJP corporators, five others
Article Text:
A new case was filed against seven individuals, including two BJP corporators, following a clash.





AMBERNATH: The political clash between BJP and Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) workers in Ambernath has taken a fresh turn, with Shivaji Nagar police registering a fresh case against seven people, including two BJP corporators, on the complaint of an MNS worker who was injured in the incident.The latest case was registered on Sunday on the complaint of Suhas Ghag, a relative of MNS Ambernath city chief Shailesh Shirke, who was also injured in the clash. Police have booked BJP corporators Abhijit Karanjule and Pawan Walekar along with five others under sections 118(1), 115(2), 189(2), 190, 191(2) and 324(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).The development comes days after police arrested Shirke and some of his associates for allegedly assaulting BJP office-bearer Laxmi Narayan Chauhan at his office in Vadavali.A subsequent clash between BJP and MNS workers at Shivaji Nagar police station further escalated tensions.MNS leaders had alleged that police took one-sided action by arresting their office-bearers while failing to act against BJP workers allegedly involved in the assault on Shirke. MNS leader Avinash Jadhav had demanded action against those responsible.Following the demand, MNS district president Bandu Deshmukh had announced a protest on Sunday against what the party termed one-sided police action. However, after police registered an FIR against BJP workers, MNS withdrew its protest.
Article Summary: A new case was filed against seven individuals, including two BJP corporators, following a clash. The latest case was registered on the complaint of Suhas Ghag, a relative of MNS Ambernath city chief Shailesh Shirke, who was also injured in the clash.

Article Title: When there are roads, accidents occur: NCP’s Bhor MLA on 10-year-old’s death
Article Text:
Bikers cross large potholes on the Nande-Mhalunge Road, where a 10-year-old boy died on Monday after he came under a truck

Pune:





Shankar Mandekar, NCP ’s Bhor MLA, on Tuesday sparked a controversy when he said that when there are roads, accidents do occur after he visited the accident spot on Nande-Mhalunge Road where a 10-year-old boy died the previous day.“It was an unfortunate incident, but when there are roads, accidents do happen. In the end, a case is registered against the owner of the bigger vehicle involved in the accident,” the Bhor MLA said during a media interaction on Tuesday afternoon.When Mandekar was asked about the delay in improving the road condition, he said, “I have been raising the issue in the assembly, but beyond that, what can I do? Even though I am a member of the party which is in the govt, the decision is taken by the ministers concerned.”The Opposition blamed state govt’s inaction for the pothole-ridden roads that resulted in the loss of life in Pune’s Mahalunge area. Residents, on the other hand, also expressed anger over the poor road conditions and said that despite repeated complaints, the road was not repaired by the authorities. Supriya Sule , NCP (SP) working president, said, “The chief minister chaired a meeting on July 10, 2025, to address the issues of Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park in Hinjewadi and Maan-Mahalunge. It was decided in that meeting that a single-point authority would resolve all the issues. However, it has been more than a year, and no progress has been made after that meeting. Now, when a 10-year-old boy died in front of his father’s eyes, who should be held responsible for it?”Adding to it, Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray , who visited the area on Tuesday, said, “The residents had held a protest at the same location demanding that the administration repair the roads, but the administration did not respond.Now, after the death of the boy, govt would give compensation of Rs 4-5 lakh to the family. That does not solve the issue.”The city unit of the Congress has demanded that Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) complete all pothole repairs before the Ganapati festival.The party submitted a memorandum to the municipal commissioner’s office regarding the repairs. Congress leaders said a large number of visitors were expected in the city during the festival. The party also demanded that the administration conduct a probe into poor-quality of road works and pothole repairs.
Article Summary: A 10-year-old boy died on Monday after he came under a truck. Shankar Mandekar, NCP ’s Bhor MLA, said that when there are roads, accidents do occur. Residents expressed anger over the poor road conditions and said that despite repeated complaints, the road was not repaired by the authorities.

Article Title: Speaker warns ministers against remarks unrelated to debate
Article Text:
Cracks whip on out-of-line remarks

Chennai:





Assembly Speaker J C D Prabhakar on Tuesday warned ministers that he would not tolerate any further out-of-line remarks and directed them to confine their responses to the subjects under discussion.The warning came after law minister R Nirmalkumar’s remarks about former chief minister M Karunanidhi triggered an uproar from the DMK. Prabhakar intervened and said he was expunging the remarks. “I don’t know why the minister is speaking in such a manner and whom he is trying to impress. I cannot permit this anymore,” he said sternly. Nirmalkumar was replying to a special calling attention motion on the gunning down of three Tamils in Karnataka forest.The Speaker said ministers could cite references and respond to matters related to the subject under discussion. They could also refer to measures taken by the previous govt on the issue but should not deviate from the context of the debate. The Speaker had, over the past few days, expunged several remarks made by ministers Nirmalkumar, Aadhav Arjuna and K G Arunraj for going off topic while responding to the opposition. He also directed members to abide by the instructions of their respective party whips.
Article Summary: The warning came after law minister R Nirmalkumar’s remarks about former chief minister M Karunanidhi triggered an uproar from the DMK. “I don’t know why the minister is speaking in such a manner and whom he is trying to impress. I cannot permit this anymore,” he said.

Article Title: Four vehicles involved in illegal sand mining seized in Krishnagiri, probe on
Article Text:
Those engaged in the illegal activity, abandoned the vehicles and fled on seeing the police approaching

Krishnagiri:





An earthmover and three tractors which were involved in illegal sand mining near Nagarasampatty in Krishnagiri district, were seized during the early hours of Monday.According to an officer, sand was being illegally excavated from the Nagaleri Lake under Avathuvadi panchayat around 2am on Monday. Acting on a tip-off, the village administrative officer S Dinesh inspected the site and confirmed that sand was being loaded into three tractors with the help of an earthmover.“Nagarasampatty police reached the spot based on his information. However, those engaged in the illegal activity, abandoned the vehicles and fled on seeing the police approaching,” the officer said.A case has been registered, and police are investigating further to trace and arrest the absconding culprits.(Photos: S Parthiban)
Article Summary: An earthmover and three tractors which were involved in illegal sand mining near Nagarasampatty in Krishnagiri district, were seized during the early hours of Monday. According to an officer, sand was being illegally excavated from the Nagaleri Lake under Avathuvadi panchayat.

Article Title: Man injured as country-made firearm goes off during hunting trip
Article Text:
Man injured as country-made firearm goes off during hunting trip





Dindigul: A 29-year-old man was injured after a country-made firearm used for hunting accidentally went off while he and another man were examining it in a forest area near Natham in Dindigul district on Tuesday. Manickam , of Chokkankulam, was admitted to the Dindigul Govt Medical College Hospital for treatment. Police said Manickam and Santhanam , 38, of Anjukulipatti went into the forest area near Kunjukulam in the foothills of Sirumalai for hunting. At that time, the duo examined the firearm, which accidentally discharged and caused an explosion. Santhanam was unhurt.Sanarpatti police brought Santhanam in for questioning and launched an inquiry into the incident. They have also seized the firearm.
Article Summary: Man injured as country-made firearm goes off during hunting trip. 29-year-old was admitted to the Dindigul Govt Medical College Hospital for treatment. Police brought Santhanam in for questioning and launched an inquiry into the incident. They have also seized the firearm.

Article Title: Truck driver dies in road accident near Salem
Article Text: SALEM: A driver died in an accident involving a truck, a pickup van and a bus near Mecheri in Salem district on Wednesday. More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident.According to the Mecheri police, a TNSTC bus carrying 51 passengers was heading to Karur from Mettur when a speeding pickup van attempted to overtake it. “The pickup van collided head-on with a truck coming from the opposite direction,” said an officer at the Mecheri police station. The truck grazed the bus, shattering its windows and injuring more than 10 passengers seated near the windows.Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. The injured were rushed to govt hospitals in Mettur and Omalur.Fire service personnel, assisted by Mecheri police and residents, worked to move the damaged truck and pickup van to the roadside. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.The Mecheri police registered a case.
Article Summary: More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident. Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.

Article Title: Augustine brothers skip hearing in cheating case
Article Text:
Muttil tree felling





Kochi: The Augustine brothers, the accused in a ‘cheating case’ linked to the controversial tree felling at Muttil in Wayanad in 2020-21, did not appear before Chottanikkara JFCM court in Ernakulam on Tuesday. It is learnt that Roji and his brothers Josekutty and Anto skipped their court appearance after filing an application for an extension.Roji and his brothers Josekutty and Anto had appeared in court last week after it issued non-bailable warrants. There was a specific court directive that all the accused must be present for the hearing on Aug 10, and the court issued non-bailable warrants after they failed to appear. The court vacated the warrants after their appearance.The case pertains to the FIR registered by Ambalamedu Police on a petition filed by MM Aliyar, proprietor of Malabar Timber Industries, Karimugal, who had alleged fraud in the sale of timber from the illegally felled trees in 2021. In July, HC dismissed the discharge petitions filed by Josekutty and Anto. The allegation is that they cheated Aliyar of Rs 1.4 crore and the FIR was registered on July 13, 2021.
Article Summary: The Augustine brothers, the accused in a ‘cheating case’ linked to the controversial tree felling at Muttil in Wayanad in 2020-21, did not appear before Chottanikkara JFCM court in Ernakulam on Tuesday. Roji and his brothers Josekutty and Anto skipped their court appearance.
